verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing has a first-party prorations doc stating that a proration can be previewed before changes are applied, so the product does prorate mid-cycle subscription changes. The pack has only this single thin mention, with nothing on how the math works or how it appears on invoices. Missing for 10: documented proration formula for partial periods, how credits for unused time are shown, invoice line-item breakdown of prorations, evidence that line items reconcile to the penny, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny

citations.quote: You can preview a proration to view the amount before applying the changes.
